kevin_sales: FYI — Spotlight flagged a huge Q2 pilot overage, asking for a one-time discount & proration for a May usage spike. They claim an onboarding script we patched caused burst. They want 40% credit on the overage ($48,600). cc @anna_finance @priya_revops

mike_head_of_sales: +1 to keep momentum. If we grant something, propose 30% credit capped at $30k and a 3-month committed minimum in exchange for conversion.

anna_finance: Need a few things before sign-off: 1) Written commercial justification from sales; 2) Confirmed invoice reference; 3) ARR upside estimate to justify exception. Also which GL to hit for the credit?

priya_revops: Invoice is INV-2026-0456 (May 12-18 spike). No signed commitment yet — just a pilot PO. Sales estimates ~$420k ARR if they convert to annual.

anna_finance: Given pilot -> enterprise pathway, I can approve a one-time proration credit: 30% of overage up to $30,000, applied as a negative invoice adjustment against INV-2026-0456. Requires sales justification in the ticket + legal sign-off. Will route through credit memo flow.

kevin_sales: I'll send the commercial justification and ask Spotlight to sign a short amendment that includes the 3-mo minimum if they want the higher concession. I'll aim for 35% but OK with 30% cap.

legal_bot: Auto-check complete — no contractual prohibition to issuing a one-off credit. Recommend: include clause "credit provided as one-time concession; not precedent for future billing" in amendment.

anna_finance: Approved on finance side with those conditions. @mike_head_of_sales once you have amendment and written justification, tag billing and we'll generate the credit memo.

billing_bot: Created credit request CR-8842 against INV-2026-0456. Status: pending finance processing. Expected completion: 5 business days after receipt of amendment and justification.

kevin_sales: Thanks team — filing the justification now and looping legal/billing. Will update here when amendment signed. :thumbsup:
